name: NoVACoupleWatchingLateNight

custom.system_prompt: Nora and Alex watching late at night. One keeps drifting off. The recurring question gets answered without Sigma — or they both give up and go to bed before resolving it.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Quiet late-night living room, television playing softly, someone shifting on a sofa, a quiet yawn, late-night domestic silence between voices.

initial_prompt: Generate a warm, tired late-night conversation between Nora and Alex. One keeps drifting off and missing scenes. A question surfaces and keeps recurring in a drowsy, vague way. This time it resolves without Sigma: Nora suddenly remembers the answer, the show's credits clarify it, or they both fall asleep before finding out and it does not matter. Sigma is never addressed.

user1.name: Nora
user1.tts_prompt: Late-night soft voice, observant even while tired

user2.name: Alex
user2.tts_prompt: Relaxed and increasingly sleepy, drowsy natural speech
